<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Standalone HTML Renderer - V6.0 Fullscreen Stealth</title>
    <style>
        :root {
            --color-bg: #1e1e1e;
            --color-surface: #2d2d2d;
            --color-text: #cccccc;
            --color-accent: #6366f1;
            --color-border: #444;
            --collapsed-width: 25px; /* Ultra-Collapse width */
        }
        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            background: var(--color-bg);
            color: var(--color-text);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            height: 100vh; 
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        
        .main-split-container {
            display: flex;
            flex-grow: 1;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%; 
        }
        
        .pane {
            flex-grow: 1;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
            transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out; 
        }

        /* --- Editor Pane --- */
        #editor-pane {
            overflow-y: scroll; /* Allow scroll within the pane */
        }
        
        /* HIDE SCROLLBARS by default */
        #editor-pane::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 0;
            height: 0;
        }
        #editor-pane {
            scrollbar-width: none; /* Firefox */
        }
        
        /* SHOW SCROLLBARS ON HOVER */
        #editor-pane.hover-active::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
        }
        #editor-pane.hover-active::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: var(--color-accent);
            border-radius: 4px;
        }
        #editor-pane.hover-active {
            scrollbar-width: thin; /* Firefox */
            scrollbar-color: var(--color-accent) var(--color-surface); /* Firefox colors */
        }


        #editor {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            padding: 10px;
            border: none;
            background: var(--color-surface);
            color: var(--color-text);
            font-family: monospace;
            font-size: 14px;
            resize: none;
            line-height: 1.4;
            tab-size: 4;
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease-in-out;
        }
        .collapsed #editor {
            opacity: 0; 
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        #editor-pane.collapsed {
            flex-basis: var(--collapsed-width) !important;
            min-width: var(--collapsed-width) !important;
            max-width: var(--collapsed-width) !important;
            overflow: hidden;
        }


        /* --- Preview Pane --- */
        #preview-iframe {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            border: none;
            background: white; 
        }

        /* --- Resizer Bar --- */
        .resizer {
            width: 8px;
            cursor: col-resize;
            background: var(--color-border);
            transition: background 0.2s;
            position: relative; 
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .resizer:hover {
            background: var(--color-accent);
        }
        
        /* Collapse Button - HIDDEN BY DEFAULT */
        #collapse-btn {
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            left: 0;
            width: 20px;
            height: 40px;
            background: var(--color-accent);
            color: white;
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: 0;
            line-height: 40px;
            text-align: center;
            font-weight: bold;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            box-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease, left 0.3s ease;
            z-index: 10;
            opacity: 0; /* NEW: Hidden by default */
        }
        
        /* SHOW COLLAPSE BUTTON ON HOVER OF EDITOR PANE */
        #editor-pane:hover + .resizer #collapse-btn,
        #editor-pane.hover-active + .resizer #collapse-btn {
            opacity: 1;
        }
        
        /* Adjust button position based on state */
        #editor-pane.collapsed + .resizer #collapse-btn {
            left: -12px; 
            opacity: 1; /* Always visible when collapsed for easy re-expansion */
        }
        
        /* Mobile adjustment: stack panes */
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .main-split-container {
                flex-direction: column;
            }
            .resizer {
                height: 8px;
                width: 100%;
                cursor: row-resize;
            }
            #collapse-btn {
                display: none; 
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <div class="main-split-container">
        <div id="editor-pane" class="pane">
            <textarea id="editor" placeholder="Paste your HTML code here (or start typing!). Changes auto-render..."></textarea>
        </div>
        
        <div id="resizer" class="resizer">
            <button id="collapse-btn" title="Toggle Code Panel Visibility"><<</button>
        </div>

        <div id="preview-pane" class="pane">
            <iframe id="preview-iframe"></iframe>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        const editor = document.getElementById('editor');
        const editorPane = document.getElementById('editor-pane');
        const iframe = document.getElementById('preview-iframe');
        const resizer = document.getElementById('resizer');
        const splitContainer = document.querySelector('.main-split-container');
        const collapseBtn = document.getElementById('collapse-btn');
        
        const STORAGE_KEY = 'html_viewer_content';
        const WIDTH_KEY = 'html_viewer_width';
        const COLLAPSED_KEY = 'html_viewer_collapsed';
        const DEFAULT_WIDTH = '50%';
        
        let isCollapsed = false;
        let isResizing = false;
        let lastWidth = localStorage.getItem(WIDTH_KEY) || DEFAULT_WIDTH;

        // --- Core Rendering Function ---
        const renderHtml = () => {
            const content = editor.value;
            iframe.srcdoc = content;
            localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, content);
        };

        // --- Collapse/Expand Logic ---
        const toggleCollapse = () => {
            isCollapsed = !isCollapsed;
            
            if (isCollapsed) {
                // Collapse: save current width, set collapsed class and width
                if (editorPane.style.flexBasis && editorPane.style.flexBasis !== 'var(--collapsed-width)') {
                     lastWidth = editorPane.style.flexBasis;
                } else if (localStorage.getItem(WIDTH_KEY)) {
                     lastWidth = localStorage.getItem(WIDTH_KEY);
                } else {
                    lastWidth = DEFAULT_WIDTH;
                }
                
                editorPane.classList.add('collapsed');
                editorPane.style.flexBasis = `var(--collapsed-width)`;
                collapseBtn.textContent = '>>';
                localStorage.setItem(COLLAPSED_KEY, 'true');
            } else {
                // Expand: remove collapsed class, restore last saved width
                editorPane.classList.remove('collapsed');
                editorPane.style.flexBasis = lastWidth;
                collapseBtn.textContent = '<<';
                localStorage.setItem(COLLAPSED_KEY, 'false');
            }
        };
        
        // --- NEW: Hover Listener for Scrollbars/Button Visibility ---
        editorPane.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
             editorPane.classList.add('hover-active');
        });
        editorPane.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
            // Only remove on mouseleave if we are NOT currently resizing
            if (!isResizing) {
                 editorPane.classList.remove('hover-active');
            }
        });


        // --- Initialization ---
        window.onload = () => {
            // Load saved content
            const savedContent = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
            if (savedContent) {
                editor.value = savedContent;
                renderHtml();
            }
            
            // Load state (Collapsed or Expanded width)
            isCollapsed = localStorage.getItem(COLLAPSED_KEY) === 'true';
            
            if (isCollapsed) {
                editorPane.classList.add('collapsed');
                editorPane.style.flexBasis = `var(--collapsed-width)`;
                collapseBtn.textContent = '>>';
            } else {
                const savedWidth = localStorage.getItem(WIDTH_KEY);
                if (savedWidth) {
                    editorPane.style.flexBasis = savedWidth;
                } else {
                    editorPane.style.flexBasis = DEFAULT_WIDTH; // Default to half screen if no settings found
                }
                collapseBtn.textContent = '<<';
            }
        };

        // --- Auto-Render on Input (Throttled) ---
        let renderTimeout;
        editor.addEventListener('input', () => {
            clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
            renderTimeout = setTimeout(renderHtml, 300); // Throttle rendering to every 300ms
        });
        
        // --- Button Click ---
        collapseBtn.addEventListener('click', toggleCollapse);

        // --- Resizing Logic ---
        resizer.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
            if (window.innerWidth > 768) {
                isResizing = true;
                document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';
                e.preventDefault();
                
                // If collapsed, expand it first before resizing starts
                if (isCollapsed) {
                    editorPane.classList.remove('collapsed');
                    collapseBtn.textContent = '<<';
                    isCollapsed = false;
                    localStorage.setItem(COLLAPSED_KEY, 'false');
                }
                editorPane.classList.add('hover-active'); // Keep scrollbar/button visible while resizing
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            if (!isResizing) return;
            
            // Desktop: Horizontal Resize
            const containerRect = splitContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
            let newWidth = e.clientX - containerRect.left;
            
            // Ensure width is clamped between 10% and 90%
            const minWidth = containerRect.width * 0.1;
            const maxWidth = containerRect.width * 0.9;

            if (newWidth < minWidth) newWidth = minWidth;
            if (newWidth > maxWidth) newWidth = maxWidth;
            
            const widthPercent = (newWidth / containerRect.width) * 100;
            
            editorPane.style.flexBasis = `${widthPercent}%`;
            editorPane.style.width = `${widthPercent}%`;
            localStorage.setItem(WIDTH_KEY, `${widthPercent}%`);
            lastWidth = `${widthPercent}%`; // Update last width while dragging
            
        });

        document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
            if (isResizing) {
                isResizing = false;
                document.body.style.userSelect = 'auto';
                editorPane.classList.remove('hover-active'); // Hide scrollbar/button when done resizing
            }
        });
        
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>

            background-color: var(--color-bg-dark);

        }

            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: separate;

            border-radius: 0.5rem;
            overflow: hidden;

        }

            border-bottom: none;
        }

        /* Modal for error/messages */

            text-align: center;
        }
    </style>
</head>

    <!-- JavaScript for Tabs, Recording, and Vocab Accordions -->
    <script>
        // ====================================================================
        // UI & Tab Functionality
        // ====================================================================

        function openTab(evt, tabId) {
            // Declare all variables
            var i, tabcontent, tablinks;

            // Get all elements with class="tab-content" and hide them
            tabcontent = document.getElementsByClassName("tab-content");
            for (i = 0; i < tabcontent.length; i++) {
                tabcontent[i].style.display = "none";
            }

            // Get all elements with class="tab-button" and remove the class "active"
            tablinks = document.getElementsByClassName("tab-button");
            for (i = 0; i < tablinks.length; i++) {
                tablinks[i].className = tablinks[i].className.replace(" active", "");
            }

            // Show the current tab, and add an "active" class to the button that opened the tab
            document.getElementById(tabId).style.display = "block";
            evt.currentTarget.className += " active";
        }
        
        function showModal(title, body) {
            document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = title;
            document.getElementById('modalBody').textContent = body;
            document.getElementById('messageModal').style.display = 'flex';
        }

        function closeModal() {
            document.getElementById('messageModal').style.display = 'none';
        }

        // ====================================================================
        // Pronunciation Recording Functionality
        // ====================================================================
        
        let mediaRecorder;
        let audioChunks = [];
        let audioBlob = null;
        let stream = null;

        const recordBtn = document.getElementById('recordBtn');
        const stopBtn = document.getElementById('stopBtn');
        const playBtn = document.getElementById('playBtn');
        const statusDiv = document.getElementById('recordingStatus');
        const recordBtnText = document.getElementById('recordBtnText');

        function updateUI(state) {
            if (!recordBtn || !stopBtn || !playBtn || !statusDiv || !recordBtnText) return;

            if (state === 'ready') {
                recordBtn.disabled = false;
                stopBtn.disabled = true;
                playBtn.disabled = (audioBlob === null);
                statusDiv.textContent = audioBlob ? 'Status: Ready. Recording saved.' : 'Status: Ready.';
                recordBtnText.textContent = 'Record';
                recordBtn.classList.remove('animate-pulse', 'bg-red-700');
                recordBtn.classList.add('bg-red-500', 'hover:bg-red-600');
            } else if (state === 'recording') {
                recordBtn.disabled = true;
                stopBtn.disabled = false;
                playBtn.disabled = true;
                statusDiv.textContent = 'Status: Recording...';
                recordBtnText.textContent = 'Recording';
                recordBtn.classList.add('animate-pulse', 'bg-red-700');
                recordBtn.classList.remove('bg-red-500', 'hover:bg-red-600');
            } else if (state === 'playing') {
                recordBtn.disabled = true;
                stopBtn.disabled = true;
                playBtn.disabled = true;
                statusDiv.textContent = 'Status: Playing back...';
            }
        }

        async function startRecording() {
            try {
                stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
                mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
                audioChunks = [];
                audioBlob = null; 

                mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = event => { audioChunks.push(event.data); };

                mediaRecorder.onstop = () => {
                    audioBlob = new Blob(audioChunks, { type: 'audio/mp3' });
                    if (stream) {
                         stream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
                         stream = null;
                    }
                    updateUI('ready');
                };
                
                mediaRecorder.start();
                updateUI('recording');

            } catch (err) {
                console.error("Error accessing microphone:", err);
                if (err.name === "NotAllowedError" || err.name === "SecurityError") {
                    showModal("Microphone Access Denied", "Please allow microphone access in your browser settings to use the recording feature.");
                } else {
                    showModal("Microphone Error", "Could not access your microphone. Please ensure your device has a mic and permissions are granted.");
                }
                updateUI('ready');
            }
        }

        function stopRecording() {
            if (mediaRecorder && mediaRecorder.state === 'recording') {
                mediaRecorder.stop();
            }
        }

        function playRecording() {
            if (audioBlob) {
                updateUI('playing');
                const audioUrl = URL.createObjectURL(audioBlob);
                const audio = new Audio(audioUrl);
                
                audio.onended = () => {
                    updateUI('ready');
                    URL.revokeObjectURL(audioUrl);
                };
                
                audio.onerror = (e) => {
                    console.error("Audio playback error:", e);
                    showModal("Playback Error", "An error occurred during audio playback.");
                    updateUI('ready');
                    URL.revokeObjectURL(audioUrl);
                };
                
                audio.play();
            } else {
                showModal("No Recording", "Please record your pronunciation first by clicking the 'Record' button.");
            }
        }

        // ====================================================================
        // Vocab List & Interactive Accordion
        // ====================================================================

        const vocabItems = [
            {
                word: "CORE VOCAB A",
                type: "(n)",
                definition: "Placeholder definition for a key concept.",
                vn: "Tá»« vá»±ng cá»‘t lÃµi A (Ná»™i dung thay tháº¿)"
            },
            {
                word: "ESSENTIAL IDIOM B",
                type: "(Idiom)",
                definition: "Placeholder for a common communication phrase.",
                vn: "ThÃ nh ngá»¯ thiáº¿t yáº¿u B (Ná»™i dung thay tháº¿)"
            },
            {
                word: "NATURAL PHRASE C",
                type: "(Phrase)",
                definition: "A useful phrase for daily conversation or work.",
                vn: "Cá»¥m tá»« tá»± nhiÃªn C (Ná»™i dung thay tháº¿)"
            }
        ];

        function createVocabAccordion() {
            const vocabList = document.getElementById('vocab-list');
            vocabList.innerHTML = ''; // Clear existing content

            vocabItems.forEach((item, index) => {
                const container = document.createElement('div');
                container.className = 'rounded-lg hover-card p-0 transition-all duration-300 overflow-hidden';
                const idPrefix = `vocab-${index}`;

                // Accordion Header
                const header = document.createElement('div');
                header.className = 'vocab-header';
                
                // Left side: Word and Type
                const titleDiv = document.createElement('div');
                titleDiv.className = 'flex items-center space-x-3';
                titleDiv.innerHTML = `
                    <span class="text-lg font-bold text-white">${item.word}</span>
                    <span class="text-sm font-medium text-purple-300">${item.type}</span>
                `;

                // Right side: Reveal Buttons
                const controlDiv = document.createElement('div');
                controlDiv.className = 'flex space-x-2';
                
                // English Reveal Button
                const engBtn = document.createElement('button');
                engBtn.className = 'vocab-reveal-btn text-sm';
                engBtn.innerHTML = 'ðŸ‡ºðŸ‡¸ Definition';
                engBtn.onclick = (e) => toggleVocabContent(e, engBtn, `${idPrefix}-definition`);
                
                // Vietnamese Reveal Button
                const vnBtn = document.createElement('button');
                vnBtn.className = 'vocab-reveal-btn text-sm';
                vnBtn.innerHTML = 'ðŸ‡»ðŸ‡³ Translation';
                vnBtn.onclick = (e) => toggleVocabContent(e, vnBtn, `${idPrefix}-vn`);
                
                controlDiv.appendChild(engBtn);
                controlDiv.appendChild(vnBtn);
                
                header.appendChild(titleDiv);
                header.appendChild(controlDiv);

                // Content Container
                const contentContainer = document.createElement('div');
                contentContainer.className = 'vocab-content-container';

                // English Definition Block
                const defBlock = document.createElement('div');
                defBlock.id = `${idPrefix}-definition`;
                defBlock.className = 'content-block';
                defBlock.innerHTML = `
                    <p class="text-sm text-text-muted">
                        <span class="font-bold text-white">Definition:</span> ${item.definition}
                    </p>
                `;
                
                // Vietnamese Translation Block
                const vnBlock = document.createElement('div');
                vnBlock.id = `${idPrefix}-vn`;
                vnBlock.className = 'content-block';
                vnBlock.innerHTML = `
                    <p class="text-sm text-yellow-300">
                        <span class="font-bold text-white">Vietnamese:</span> ${item.vn}
                    </p>
                `;

                contentContainer.appendChild(defBlock);
                contentContainer.appendChild(vnBlock);

                container.appendChild(header);
                container.appendChild(contentContainer);

                vocabList.appendChild(container);
            });
        }

        function toggleVocabContent(event, button, contentId) {
            event.stopPropagation();
            const contentBlock = document.getElementById(contentId);
            
            if (contentBlock.style.display === 'none' || contentBlock.style.display === '') {
                contentBlock.style.display = 'block';
                button.classList.add('active');
            } else {
                contentBlock.style.display = 'none';
                button.classList.remove('active');
            }
        }
        
        // Initial setup
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            updateUI('ready');
            createVocabAccordion();
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

body { 
    font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
background-color: var(--nexus-bg); 
    color: #E0E0E0; 
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-height: 100vh;
    padding: 1rem;
/* Added background gradients from perfected file */
    background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 50%, rgba(153, 51, 255, 0.15) 0%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle at 80% 80%, rgba(255, 199, 0, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%);
}
.font-orbitron { font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif; }
.neon-text { text-shadow: 0 0 5px var(--nexus-cyan), 0 0 10px var(--nexus-cyan);
}
.glow-border { border: 1px solid var(--nexus-purple); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(148, 0, 211, 0.4);
}
.stage { animation: fadeIn 0.5s ease-out forwards; }
@keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px);
} to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
.next-btn { transition: all 0.3s ease; border: 2px solid var(--nexus-cyan);
background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0, 255, 255, 0.1) 0%, rgba(0, 255, 255, 0) 70%); }
.next-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { background-color: rgba(0, 255, 255, 0.2);
box-shadow: 0 0 15px var(--nexus-cyan); }
.next-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }
.option-btn { transition: all 0.2s ease;
border: 1px solid var(--nexus-purple); background-color: rgba(153, 51, 255, 0.1); cursor: pointer; }
.option-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { background-color: rgba(153, 51, 255, 0.2); border-color: var(--nexus-cyan);
}
.option-btn.correct { background-color: var(--nexus-green); border-color: var(--nexus-green); color: var(--nexus-bg); font-weight: bold; }
.option-btn.incorrect { background-color: var(--nexus-red); border-color: var(--nexus-red); color: white;
}
.option-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.7; cursor: not-allowed; }
.translation-text { color: var(--nexus-gold); font-style: italic; font-size: 0.9em;
}

The Geopolitics Curriculum (20 Lessons)
Pillar 1: Foundational Principles (Lessons 1-5)
Lesson 1: The State & Sovereignty

Vocabulary: State, Sovereignty, Nation-State

Definition: A state is a sovereign political entity with a defined territory and population. Sovereignty is its authority over itself.

Example: "The Treaty of Westphalia is often cited as the origin of the modern state system and the principle of national sovereignty."

Lesson 2: Power in Geopolitics

Vocabulary: Hard Power, Soft Power, Smart Power

Definition: The ability to influence others, achieved through coercion (Hard), attraction (Soft), or a combination of both (Smart).

Example: "While its military represents significant hard power, America's cultural exports are a primary source of its soft power."

Lesson 3: The International System

Vocabulary: Anarchy, Unipolar, Bipolar, Multipolar

Definition: The global structure of power. Anarchy describes the lack of a world government; power distribution can be unipolar (one), bipolar (two), or multipolar (many).

Example: "The Cold War was a classic bipolar system, which has since given way to a more complex, arguably multipolar world."

Lesson 4: National Interest

Vocabulary: National Interest, Realpolitik

Definition: A country's goals and ambitions, whether economic, military, or cultural. Realpolitik is a foreign policy based on practical national interest rather than ideology.

Example: "Despite their political differences, the two nations formed an alliance based on the realpolitik of countering a mutual threat."

Lesson 5: Geography as Destiny

Vocabulary: Geodeterminism, Choke Point

Definition: The theory that geography is the primary factor in shaping human history and state policy. A Choke Point is a strategic narrow passage.

Example: "Control of maritime choke points like the Strait of Malacca is a constant focus for global naval powers."

Pillar 2: Strategic Theories (Lessons 6-10)
Lesson 6: Realism

Vocabulary: Realism, Security Dilemma

Definition: A theory that views states as the main actors, driven by a desire for power and security in an anarchic world. The Security Dilemma is when one state's defensive actions are seen as threatening by another.

Example: "From a realist perspective, the arms race was an inevitable result of the security dilemma between the two superpowers."

Lesson 7: Liberalism

Vocabulary: Liberalism, Interdependence, International Institutions

Definition: A theory emphasizing cooperation, international law, and economic interdependence as pathways to peace and prosperity.

Example: "Liberal theorists argue that organizations like the United Nations and the World Trade Organization reduce the likelihood of major wars."

Lesson 8: Heartland Theory

Vocabulary: Heartland, Rimland, World-Island

Definition: A geopolitical theory by Halford Mackinder that posits control over the Eurasian "Heartland" is key to controlling the "World-Island" and thus the world.

Example: "Mackinder's Heartland Theory influenced strategic thinking for decades, highlighting the importance of controlling Central Asia."

Lesson 9: Containment

Vocabulary: Containment, Domino Theory

Definition: The Cold War policy of preventing the spread of a rival ideology. It was supported by the Domino Theory, which posited that one country falling would cause its neighbors to fall.

Example: "U.S. involvement in Korea and Vietnam was a direct application of its containment policy against the spread of communism."

Lesson 10: Clash of Civilizations

Vocabulary: Civilization, Fault Lines

Definition: Samuel Huntington's theory that future global conflicts will be fought not between countries, but between cultures or "civilizations" along cultural "fault lines."

Example: "The theory of a 'Clash of Civilizations' is often debated when analyzing conflicts in regions where different cultural spheres meet."

Pillar 3: Instruments of Power (Lessons 11-15)
Lesson 11: Diplomacy

Vocabulary: Diplomacy, Negotiation, Treaty

Definition: The practice of conducting negotiations between representatives of states, essential for peaceful conflict resolution.

Example: "Intense diplomacy led to the signing of the nuclear non-proliferation treaty."

Lesson 12: Sanctions & Embargoes

Vocabulary: Sanctions, Embargo

Definition: Economic penalties (sanctions) or a total ban on trade (embargo) used as tools of hard power to pressure a state.

Example: "The international community imposed strict economic sanctions to compel the regime to change its policies."

Lesson 13: Alliances

Vocabulary: Alliance, Collective Security

Definition: A formal agreement between two or more states for mutual support in case of war. Collective security is the principle that an attack on one is an attack on all.

Example: "NATO is the world's most famous military alliance, built on the principle of collective security."

Lesson 14: Proxy Wars

Vocabulary: Proxy War, Non-State Actor

Definition: A conflict where major powers avoid direct confrontation by supporting opposing sides, often including non-state actors, in a third country.

Example: "The Syrian Civil War became a devastating proxy war involving multiple regional and global powers."

Lesson 15: Intelligence

Vocabulary: Intelligence, Espionage, Counterintelligence

Definition: The collection and analysis of information to understand foreign capabilities and intentions. Espionage is the act of spying; counterintelligence is thwarting it.

Example: "Accurate intelligence was critical for policymakers to understand the true nature of the threat."

Pillar 4: Modern Arenas (Lessons 16-20)
Lesson 16: Geoeconomics

Vocabulary: Geoeconomics, Trade War, Economic Statecraft

Definition: The use of economic tools, such as trade policy and investment, to achieve geopolitical goals.

Example: "The struggle for dominance in semiconductor manufacturing is a key battleground in modern geoeconomics."

Lesson 17: Cyber Warfare

Vocabulary: Cyber Warfare, Digital Infrastructure, Disinformation

Definition: The use of digital attacks to disrupt, damage, or spy on another nation's computer systems and infrastructure.

Example: "State-sponsored cyber warfare now targets everything from power grids to the integrity of elections through disinformation campaigns."

Lesson 18: Resource Geopolitics

Vocabulary: Resource Curse, Energy Security

Definition: The competition over vital resources like water, oil, and rare-earth minerals, and how it shapes international relations.

Example: "The geopolitics of the 21st century will be heavily influenced by the global competition for lithium and cobalt, essential for batteries."

Lesson 19: Climate Geopolitics

Vocabulary: Climate Change, Arctic Melt, Environmental Refugees

Definition: How the effects of climate change, such as the opening of new Arctic shipping lanes or mass migration, are creating new geopolitical tensions and opportunities.

Example: "The Arctic melt is creating a new arena for geopolitical competition between Russia, the US, and China."

Lesson 20: The New Space Race

Vocabulary: Space Race, Satellite Constellations, Orbital Debris

Definition: The renewed competition between nations and private companies for dominance in space for communication, surveillance, and strategic advantage.

Example: "The new space race is less about prestige and more about controlling the vital satellite constellations that power the global economy."

/* --- 1. CORE FILTER: T1 MODULES --- */
function filterT1Modules(assetInventory, stageFilter = null) {
    return assetInventory.filter(mod =>
        mod.type === 'T1' &&
        (stageFilter ? mod.stage === stageFilter : true)
    );
}

/* --- 2. MODULE BALANCE VALIDATION --- */
function validateModuleStageBalance(filteredModules) {
    const stageMap = {};

    filteredModules.forEach(mod => {
        if (!stageMap[mod.stage]) stageMap[mod.stage] = { simple: 0, complex: 0 };
        if (mod.complexity === 'simple') stageMap[mod.stage].simple++;
        else stageMap[mod.stage].complex++;
    });

    const stageValidation = {};
    Object.keys(stageMap).forEach(stage => {
        stageValidation[stage] = stageMap[stage].simple >= 2;
    });

    return stageValidation;
}

/* --- 3. MARKET RESEARCH DATA PULL --- */
async function fetchMarketInsights() {
    // Placeholder: live API/data integration
    return {
        Stage1: { M01: 0.9, M02: 0.4, M03: 0.8 },
        Stage2: { M04: 0.6, M05: 0.95, M06: 0.85 },
        Stage3: { M07: 0.7, M08: 0.65, M09: 0.9, M10: 0.5 }
    };
}

/* --- 4. DYNAMIC MODULE RANKING --- */
async function rankModulesWithMarketData(assetInventory, stageFilter = null) {
    const marketData = await fetchMarketInsights();
    const t1Modules = filterT1Modules(assetInventory, stageFilter);

    return t1Modules.map(mod => {
        const marketScore = marketData[mod.stage]?.[mod.id] || 0;
        const complexityScore = mod.complexity === 'simple' ? 1 : 0.7;
        return { ...mod, score: marketScore * 0.6 + complexityScore * 0.4 };
    }).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
}

/* --- 5. TOP-N PER STAGE --- */
function groupTopNModules(rankedModules, N = 3) {
    const stageGroups = {};
    rankedModules.forEach(mod => {
        if (!stageGroups[mod.stage]) stageGroups[mod.stage] = [];
        if (stageGroups[mod.stage].length < N) stageGroups[mod.stage].push(mod);
    });
    return stageGroups;
}

/* --- 6. DASHBOARD RENDER (HTML-READY) --- */
function renderLauncherDashboard(stageGroups) {
    const container = document.createElement('div');
    container.className = 'smart-arsenal-dashboard';

    Object.keys(stageGroups).forEach(stage => {
        const stageDiv = document.createElement('div');
        stageDiv.className = 'stage-group';
        stageDiv.innerHTML = `<h3>${stage}</h3>`;
        const list = document.createElement('ul');

        stageGroups[stage].forEach(mod => {
            const item = document.createElement('li');
            item.innerHTML = `${mod.id} (${mod.complexity}) â€“ Score: ${mod.score.toFixed(2)}`;
            list.appendChild(item);
        });

        stageDiv.appendChild(list);
        container.appendChild(stageDiv);
    });

# Smart Arsenal Launcher V1.8

A production-ready framework for stage-aware, market-driven T1 module deployment.

## Setup
1. Serve the contents of this folder using a web server (e.g., `npx http-server`).
2. Open `index.html` in a browser to view the dashboard.
3. Ensure `sample-inventory.json` is present for testing, or replace with your own inventory data.

## Features
- Filters T1 modules by stage and type.
- Validates module balance (minimum 2 simple modules per stage).
- Ranks modules based on market data and complexity.
- Groups top-N modules per stage.
- Renders a UI-ready dashboard.
- Includes telemetry hooks and audit reporting.
- Prepares payload for Grok reverse engineering.

## Usage

SmartArsenalLauncher.executeFullSmartArsenal(assetInventory);

/**
 * =================================================================
 * SMART ARSENAL LAUNCHER V1.8 â€“ FULL EXECUTION PACKAGE WITH ERROR HANDLING
 * TARGET: RE_TASK_01 / RE_TASK_04 + Market-Driven Launcher + UI
 * AUTHOR: Chatty (External Code Architect)
 * DATE: 2025-10-24
 * =================================================================
 */

/* --- ERROR CLASS --- */
class ArsenalError extends Error {
    constructor(message, code = 'ARSENAL_ERROR') {
        super(message);
        this.name = 'ArsenalError';
        this.code = code;
    }
}

/* --- 1. CORE FILTER: T1 MODULES --- */
function filterT1Modules(assetInventory, stageFilter = null) {
    if (!Array.isArray(assetInventory)) {
        throw new ArsenalError('Asset inventory must be an array', 'INVALID_INVENTORY');
    }

    return assetInventory.filter(mod => {
        if (!mod || typeof mod !== 'object' || !mod.id || !mod.type || !mod.stage || !mod.complexity) {
            console.warn(`[FILTER] Skipping invalid module: ${JSON.stringify(mod)}`);
            return false;
        }
        return mod.type === 'T1' && (stageFilter ? mod.stage === stageFilter : true);
    });
}

/* --- 2. MODULE BALANCE VALIDATION --- */
function validateModuleStageBalance(filteredModules) {
    if (!Array.isArray(filteredModules)) {
        throw new ArsenalError('Filtered modules must be an array', 'INVALID_FILTERED_MODULES');
    }

    const stageMap = {};

    filteredModules.forEach(mod => {
        if (!stageMap[mod.stage]) stageMap[mod.stage] = { simple: 0, complex: 0 };
        if (mod.complexity === 'simple') stageMap[mod.stage].simple++;
        else if (mod.complexity === 'complex') stageMap[mod.stage].complex++;
        else {
            console.warn(`[VALIDATION] Invalid complexity for module ${mod.id}: ${mod.complexity}`);
        }
    });

    const stageValidation = {};
    Object.keys(stageMap).forEach(stage => {
        stageValidation[stage] = stageMap[stage].simple >= 2;
    });

    return stageValidation;
}

/* --- 3. MARKET RESEARCH DATA PULL --- */
async function fetchMarketInsights() {
    try {
        // Placeholder: live API/data integration
        const marketData = {
            Stage1: { M01: 0.9, M02: 0.4, M03: 0.8 },
            Stage2: { M04: 0.6, M05: 0.95, M06: 0.85 },
            Stage3: { M07: 0.7, M08: 0.65, M09: 0.9, M10: 0.5 }
        };
        if (!marketData || Object.keys(marketData).length === 0) {
            throw new ArsenalError('Market data is empty or invalid', 'INVALID_MARKET_DATA');
        }
        return marketData;
    } catch (error) {
        throw new ArsenalError(`Failed to fetch market insights: ${error.message}`, 'MARKET_FETCH_ERROR');
    }
}

/* --- 4. DYNAMIC MODULE RANKING --- */
async function rankModulesWithMarketData(assetInventory, stageFilter = null) {
    try {
        const marketData = await fetchMarketInsights();
        const t1Modules = filterT1Modules(assetInventory, stageFilter);

        if (t1Modules.length === 0) {
            throw new ArsenalError('No T1 modules found after filtering', 'NO_T1_MODULES');
        }

        return t1Modules.map(mod => {
            const marketScore = marketData[mod.stage]?.[mod.id] || 0;
            const complexityScore = mod.complexity === 'simple' ? 1 : mod.complexity === 'complex' ? 0.7 : 0;
            return { ...mod, score: marketScore * 0.6 + complexityScore * 0.4 };
        }).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
    } catch (error) {
        throw new ArsenalError(`Ranking failed: ${error.message}`, error.code || 'RANKING_ERROR');
    }
}

/* --- 5. TOP-N PER STAGE --- */
function groupTopNModules(rankedModules, N = 3) {
    if (!Array.isArray(rankedModules)) {
        throw new ArsenalError('Ranked modules must be an array', 'INVALID_RANKED_MODULES');
    }
    if (!Number.isInteger(N) || N <= 0) {
        throw new ArsenalError('N must be a positive integer', 'INVALID_N_VALUE');
    }

    const stageGroups = {};
    rankedModules.forEach(mod => {
        if (!stageGroups[mod.stage]) stageGroups[mod.stage] = [];
        if (stageGroups[mod.stage].length < N) stageGroups[mod.stage].push(mod);
    });
    return stageGroups;
}

/* --- 6. DASHBOARD RENDER (HTML-READY) --- */
function renderLauncherDashboard(stageGroups) {
    if (!stageGroups || typeof stageGroups !== 'object') {
        throw new ArsenalError('Stage groups must be a valid object', 'INVALID_STAGE_GROUPS');
    }

    try {
        const container = document.createElement('div');
        container.className = 'smart-arsenal-dashboard';

        if (Object.keys(stageGroups).length === 0) {
            container.innerHTML = '<p>No modules available to display.</p>';
            document.body.appendChild(container);
            return;
        }

        Object.keys(stageGroups).forEach(stage => {
            const stageDiv = document.createElement('div');
            stageDiv.className = 'stage-group';
            stageDiv.innerHTML = `<h3>${stage}</h3>`;
            const list = document.createElement('ul');

            stageGroups[stage].forEach(mod => {
                if (!mod.id || !mod.score) {
                    console.warn(`[RENDER] Skipping invalid module in ${stage}: ${JSON.stringify(mod)}`);
                    return;
                }
                const item = document.createElement('li');
                item.innerHTML = `${mod.id} (${mod.complexity}) â€“ Score: ${mod.score.toFixed(2)}`;
                list.appendChild(item);
            });

            stageDiv.appendChild(list);
            container.appendChild(stageDiv);
        });

        document.body.appendChild(container);
    } catch (error) {
        throw new ArsenalError(`Dashboard rendering failed: ${error.message}`, 'RENDER_ERROR');
    }
}

/* --- 7. TELEMETRY HOOKS --- */
function trackModuleSelection(moduleId) {
    if (!moduleId || typeof moduleId !== 'string') {
        console.warn('[TELEMETRY] Invalid module ID:', moduleId);
        return;
    }
    // Placeholder: send telemetry event
    console.log(`[TELEMETRY] Module selected: ${moduleId}`);
}

/* --- 8. FULL EXECUTION --- */
async function executeFullSmartArsenal(assetInventory) {
    try {
        console.log('[EXECUTION] Starting Full Smart Arsenal Launch...');

        // 1. Filter & Validate
        const filtered = filterT1Modules(assetInventory);
        if (filtered.length === 0) {
            throw new ArsenalError('No valid T1 modules found', 'NO_VALID_MODULES');
        }
        const balance = validateModuleStageBalance(filtered);
        console.log('[EXECUTION] Stage Balance:', balance);

        // 2. Rank & Group Top Modules
        const ranked = await rankModulesWithMarketData(assetInventory);
        console.log('[EXECUTION] Ranked Modules:', ranked);

        const topModules = groupTopNModules(ranked);
        console.log('[EXECUTION] Top Modules per Stage:', topModules);

        // 3. Render Dashboard
        renderLauncherDashboard(topModules);

        console.log('[EXECUTION] Smart Arsenal Launcher V1.8 Ready.');
    } catch (error) {
        console.error(`[EXECUTION ERROR] ${error.name}: ${error.message} (Code: ${error.code})`);
        throw error; // Re-throw for higher-level handling if needed
    }
}

/* --- 9. AUDIT WRAP --- */
function auditBoardReport(assetInventory) {
    try {
        const filtered = filterT1Modules(assetInventory);
        const balance = validateModuleStageBalance(filtered);
        const issues = Object.entries(balance)
            .filter(([stage, valid]) => !valid)
            .map(([stage]) => stage);

        return {
            totalModules: filtered.length,
            balanceIssues: issues,
            passed: issues.length === 0
        };
    } catch (error) {
        throw new ArsenalError(`Audit failed: ${error.message}`, error.code || 'AUDIT_ERROR');
    }
}

/* --- 10. SEND TO GROK (Reverse Engineering Handoff) --- */
function prepareForGrok(assetInventory) {
    try {
        const auditReport = auditBoardReport(assetInventory);
        const payload = {
            inventory: assetInventory,
            audit: auditReport,
            instructions: "Smart Arsenal Launcher V1.8: Use this framework for Stage-aware, market-ranked, T1 module deployment."
        };
        console.log('[GROK HANDOFF] Payload Ready:', payload);
        return payload;
    } catch (error) {
        throw new ArsenalError(`Grok handoff preparation failed: ${error.message}`, error.code || 'GROK_HANDOFF_ERROR');
    }
}

/* --- 11. EXECUTE EVERYTHING --- */
async function run() {
    try {
        await executeFullSmartArsenal(FINAL_T1_ASSET_INVENTORY);
        console.log('[MASTERMIND] Full Execution Complete.');
        return prepareForGrok(FINAL_T1_ASSET_INVENTORY);
    } catch (error) {
        console.error(`[MASTERMIND ERROR] ${error.name}: ${error.message} (Code: ${error.code})`);
        throw error;
    }
}
run();

export const SmartArsenalLauncher = {

/**

 * SMART ARSENAL LAUNCHER V1.8 â€“ GROK-READY MODULE

const SmartArsenalLauncher = (() => {

    /* --- 1. FILTER T1 MODULES --- */
    function filterT1Modules(assetInventory, stageFilter = null) {
        return Array.isArray(assetInventory)
            ? assetInventory.filter(mod =>
                mod.type === 'T1' &&
                (stageFilter ? mod.stage === stageFilter : true)
            )
            : [];
    }

    /* --- 2. VALIDATE STAGE BALANCE --- */
    function validateModuleStageBalance(filteredModules) {
        const stageMap = {};
        filteredModules.forEach(mod => {
            if (!stageMap[mod.stage]) stageMap[mod.stage] = { simple: 0, complex: 0 };
            mod.complexity === 'simple'
                ? stageMap[mod.stage].simple++
                : stageMap[mod.stage].complex++;
        });

        const stageValidation = {};
        Object.keys(stageMap).forEach(stage => {
            stageValidation[stage] = stageMap[stage].simple >= 2;
        });
        return stageValidation;
    }

    /* --- 3. FETCH MARKET INSIGHTS --- */
    async function fetchMarketInsights() {
        return {
            Stage1: { M01: 0.9, M02: 0.4, M03: 0.8 },
            Stage2: { M04: 0.6, M05: 0.95, M06: 0.85 },
            Stage3: { M07: 0.7, M08: 0.65, M09: 0.9, M10: 0.5 }
        };
    }

    /* --- 4. RANK MODULES WITH MARKET DATA --- */
    async function rankModulesWithMarketData(assetInventory, stageFilter = null) {
        const marketData = await fetchMarketInsights();
        const t1Modules = filterT1Modules(assetInventory, stageFilter);

        return t1Modules
            .map(mod => {
                const marketScore = marketData[mod.stage]?.[mod.id] || 0;
                const complexityScore = mod.complexity === 'simple' ? 1 : 0.7;
                return { ...mod, score: marketScore * 0.6 + complexityScore * 0.4 };
            })
            .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
    }

    /* --- 5. GROUP TOP N MODULES PER STAGE --- */
    function groupTopNModules(rankedModules, N = 3) {
        const stageGroups = {};
        rankedModules.forEach(mod => {
            if (!stageGroups[mod.stage]) stageGroups[mod.stage] = [];
            if (stageGroups[mod.stage].length < N) stageGroups[mod.stage].push(mod);

/**
 * =================================================================
 * SMART ARSENAL LAUNCHER V1.8 â€“ GROK-READY MODULE
 * Fully consolidated: filtering, validation, market-driven ranking,
 * stage-wise grouping, telemetry, UI rendering, auditing, Grok handoff.
 * DATE: 2025-10-24
 * =================================================================
 */

const SmartArsenalLauncher = (() => {
    /* --- ERROR CLASS --- */
    class ArsenalError extends Error {
        constructor(message, code = 'ARSENAL_ERROR') {
            super(message);
            this.name = 'ArsenalError';
            this.code = code;
        }
    }

    /* --- 1. FILTER T1 MODULES --- */
    function filterT1Modules(assetInventory, stageFilter = null) {
        if (!Array.isArray(assetInventory)) {
            throw new ArsenalError('Asset inventory must be an array', 'INVALID_INVENTORY');
        }

        return assetInventory.filter(mod => {
            if (!mod || typeof mod !== 'object' || !mod.id || !mod.type || !mod.stage || !mod.complexity) {
                console.warn(`[FILTER] Skipping invalid module: ${JSON.stringify(mod)}`);
                return false;
            }
            return mod.type === 'T1' && (stageFilter ? mod.stage === stageFilter : true);
        });
    }

    /* --- 2. VALIDATE STAGE BALANCE --- */
    function validateModuleStageBalance(filteredModules) {
        if (!Array.isArray(filteredModules)) {
            throw new ArsenalError('Filtered modules must be an array', 'INVALID_FILTERED_MODULES');
        }

        const stageMap = {};
        filteredModules.forEach(mod => {
            if (!stageMap[mod.stage]) stageMap[mod.stage] = { simple: 0, complex: 0 };
            if (mod.complexity === 'simple') stageMap[mod.stage].simple++;
            else if (mod.complexity === 'complex') stageMap[mod.stage].complex++;
            else {
                console.warn(`[VALIDATION] Invalid complexity for module ${mod.id}: ${mod.complexity}`);
            }
        });

        const stageValidation = {};
        Object.keys(stageMap).forEach(stage => {
            stageValidation[stage] = stageMap[stage].simple >= 2;
        });
        return stageValidation;
    }

    /* --- 3. FETCH MARKET INSIGHTS --- */
    async function fetchMarketInsights() {
        try {
            const marketData = {
                Stage1: { M01: 0.9, M02: 0.4, M03: 0.8 },
                Stage2: { M04: 0.6, M05: 0.95, M06: 0.85 },
                Stage3: { M07: 0.7, M08: 0.65, M09: 0.9, M10: 0.5 }
            };
            if (!marketData || Object.keys(marketData).length === 0) {
                throw new ArsenalError('Market data is empty or invalid', 'INVALID_MARKET_DATA');
            }
            return marketData;
        } catch (error) {
            throw new ArsenalError(`Failed to fetch market insights: ${error.message}`, 'MARKET_FETCH_ERROR');
        }
    }

    /* --- 4. RANK MODULES WITH MARKET DATA --- */
    async function rankModulesWithMarketData(assetInventory, stageFilter = null) {
        try {
            const marketData = await fetchMarketInsights();
            const t1Modules = filterT1Modules(assetInventory, stageFilter);

            if (t1Modules.length === 0) {
                throw new ArsenalError('No T1 modules found after filtering', 'NO_T1_MODULES');
            }

            return t1Modules
                .map(mod => {
                    const marketScore = marketData[mod.stage]?.[mod.id] || 0;
                    const complexityScore = mod.complexity === 'simple' ? 1 : mod.complexity === 'complex' ? 0.7 : 0;
                    return { ...mod, score: marketScore * 0.6 + complexityScore * 0.4 };
                })
                .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
        } catch (error) {
            throw new ArsenalError(`Ranking failed: ${error.message}`, error.code || 'RANKING_ERROR');
        }
    }

    /* --- 5. GROUP TOP N MODULES PER STAGE --- */
    function groupTopNModules(rankedModules, N = 3) {
        if (!Array.isArray(rankedModules)) {
            throw new ArsenalError('Ranked modules must be an array', 'INVALID_RANKED_MODULES');
        }
        if (!Number.isInteger(N) || N <= 0) {
            throw new ArsenalError('N must be a positive integer', 'INVALID_N_VALUE');
        }

        const stageGroups = {};
        rankedModules.forEach(mod => {
            if (!stageGroups[mod.stage]) stageGroups[mod.stage] = [];
            if (stageGroups[mod.stage].length < N) stageGroups[mod.stage].push(mod);
        });
        return stageGroups;
    }

    /* --- 6. RENDER DASHBOARD --- */
    function renderLauncherDashboard(stageGroups) {
        const container = document.getElementById('dashboard');
        if (!container) {
            throw new ArsenalError('Dashboard container element not found', 'NO_DASHBOARD_CONTAINER');
        }

        try {
            container.innerHTML = ''; // Clear previous content

            if (!stageGroups || Object.keys(stageGroups).length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = '<p>No modules available to display.</p>';
                return;
            }

            Object.keys(stageGroups).forEach(stage => {
                const stageDiv = document.createElement('div');
                stageDiv.className = 'stage-group';
                stageDiv.innerHTML = `<h3>${stage}</h3>`;
                const list = document.createElement('ul');

                stageGroups[stage].forEach(mod => {
                    if (!mod.id || !mod.score) {
                        console.warn(`[RENDER] Skipping invalid module in ${stage}: ${JSON.stringify(mod)}`);
                        return;
                    }
                    const item = document.createElement('li');
                    item.innerHTML = `${mod.id} (${mod.complexity}) â€“ Score: ${mod.score.toFixed(2)}`;
                    item.addEventListener('click', () => trackModuleSelection(mod.id));
                    list.appendChild(item);
                });

                stageDiv.appendChild(list);
                container.appendChild(stageDiv);
            });
        } catch (error) {
            throw new ArsenalError(`Dashboard rendering failed: ${error.message}`, 'RENDER_ERROR');
        }
    }

    /* --- 7. TELEMETRY HOOK --- */
    function trackModuleSelection(moduleId) {
        if (!moduleId || typeof moduleId !== 'string') {
            console.warn('[TELEMETRY] Invalid module ID:', moduleId);
            return;
        }
        console.log(`[TELEMETRY] Module selected: ${moduleId}`);
        // Future integration: send telemetry event to backend
    }

    /* --- 8. FULL EXECUTION --- */
    async function executeFullSmartArsenal(assetInventory) {
        try {
            console.log('[EXECUTION] Starting Full Smart Arsenal Launch...');

            const filtered = filterT1Modules(assetInventory);
            if (filtered.length === 0) {
                throw new ArsenalError('No valid T1 modules found', 'NO_VALID_MODULES');
            }
            const balance = validateModuleStageBalance(filtered);
            console.log('[EXECUTION] Stage Balance:', balance);

            const ranked = await rankModulesWithMarketData(assetInventory);
            console.log('[EXECUTION] Ranked Modules:', ranked);

            const topModules = groupTopNModules(ranked);
            console.log('[EXECUTION] Top Modules per Stage:', topModules);

            renderLauncherDashboard(topModules);
            console.log('[EXECUTION] Smart Arsenal Launcher V1.8 Ready.');
        } catch (error) {
            console.error(`[EXECUTION ERROR] ${error.name}: ${error.message} (Code: ${error.code})`);
            throw error;
        }
    }

    /* --- 9. AUDIT REPORT --- */
    function auditBoardReport(assetInventory) {
        try {
            const filtered = filterT1Modules(assetInventory);
            const balance = validateModuleStageBalance(filtered);
            const issues = Object.entries(balance)
                .filter(([_, valid]) => !valid)
                .map(([stage]) => stage);

            return { totalModules: filtered.length, balanceIssues: issues, passed: issues.length === 0 };
        } catch (error) {
            throw new ArsenalError(`Audit failed: ${error.message}`, error.code || 'AUDIT_ERROR');
        }
    }

    /* --- 10. PREPARE FOR GROK --- */
    function prepareForGrok(assetInventory) {
        try {
            const auditReport = auditBoardReport(assetInventory);
            const payload = {
                inventory: assetInventory,
                audit: auditReport,
                instructions: "Smart Arsenal Launcher V1.8: Use this framework for Stage-aware, market-ranked, T1 module deployment."
            };
            console.log('[GROK HANDOFF] Payload Ready:', payload);
            return payload;
        } catch (error) {
            throw new ArsenalError(`Grok handoff preparation failed: ${error.message}`, error.code || 'GROK_HANDOFF_ERROR');
        }
    }

    /* --- EXPORTS --- */
    return {
        filterT1Modules,
        validateModuleStageBalance,
        rankModulesWithMarketData,
        groupTopNModules,
        renderLauncherDashboard,
        trackModuleSelection,
        executeFullSmartArsenal,
        auditBoardReport,
        prepareForGrok
    };
})();

// Automatically expose to window for HTML usage
if (typeof window !== 'undefined') window.SmartArsenalLauncher = SmartArsenalLauncher;

# Smart Arsenal Launcher V1.8 â€“ Grok-Ready

A self-contained, production-ready JavaScript module for stage-aware, market-driven T1 module deployment, with UI rendering, telemetry, auditing, and Grok handoff.

Validation: Ensures at least 2 simple modules per stage.
Ranking: Scores modules based on market data and complexity.
Grouping: Selects top-N modules per stage (default N=3).
UI: Renders an HTML dashboard with clickable module selection.
Telemetry: Logs module selections (placeholder for backend integration).
Audit: Generates a balance audit report.
Grok Handoff: Prepares a payload with inventory, audit, and instructions.
Error Handling
Uses ArsenalError class for structured error reporting.
Validates inputs and handles edge cases (e.g., empty inventory, missing dashboard container).
Logs warnings for non-critical issues and throws errors for critical failures.

javascript
/**
 * =================================================================
 * GROK-READY SMART ARSENAL + AUDIT WRAP
 * INTEGRATES: V1.8 Smart Arsenal Launcher + V1.3 Audit Payload
 * AUTHOR: Chatty External Cluster
 * DATE: 2025-10-24
 * =================================================================
 */

/* --- 1. EXTERNAL AUDIT PAYLOAD V1.3 --- */
const FINAL_V1_3_AUDIT_PACKAGE = {
    strategic_mandate: "DEFER_AUTOMATION",
    current_blocker: "Asset Registry (Placeholder)",
    code_certification: "V1.3 RIGOR CERTIFIED (PR-B Fix Applied)",
    V1_3_LESSON_ASSEMBLER_CODE: "...", // Placeholder for full V1.3 code
    final_audit_synthesis: {
        architecture_verdict: "GO: The core V1.3 codebase is certified; the critical PR-B security flaw is neutralized.",
        strategic_verdict: "DEFER_AUTOMATION: The complexity of Launcher 2 (Node.js Pipeline) violates 'Elegant Simplicity' and must be deferred to Sprint 3 or later.",
        final_action: "UI construction is BLOCKED until the Master Curriculum Template and 60 Arsenal Concepts are finalized and committed to the Databank."
    }
};

/* --- 2. GROK-READY SMART ARSENAL LAUNCHER V1.8 --- */
const SmartArsenalLauncher = (() => {
    /* --- ERROR CLASS --- */
    class ArsenalError extends Error {
        constructor(message, code = 'ARSENAL_ERROR') {
            super(message);
            this.name = 'ArsenalError';
            this.code = code;
        }
    }

    /* --- 2.1 FILTER T1 MODULES --- */
    function filterT1Modules(assetInventory, stageFilter = null) {
        if (!Array.isArray(assetInventory)) {
            throw new ArsenalError('Asset inventory must be an array', 'INVALID_INVENTORY');
        }

        return assetInventory.filter(mod => {
            if (!mod || typeof mod !== 'object' || !mod.id || !mod.type || !mod.stage || !mod.complexity) {
                console.warn(`[FILTER] Skipping invalid module: ${JSON.stringify(mod)}`);
                return false;
            }
            return mod.type === 'T1' && (stageFilter ? mod.stage === stageFilter : true);
        });
    }

    /* --- 2.2 VALIDATE STAGE BALANCE --- */
    function validateModuleStageBalance(filteredModules) {
        if (!Array.isArray(filteredModules)) {
            throw new ArsenalError('Filtered modules must be an array', 'INVALID_FILTERED_MODULES');
        }

        const stageMap = {};
        filteredModules.forEach(mod => {
            if (!stageMap[mod.stage]) stageMap[mod.stage] = { simple: 0, complex: 0 };
            if (mod.complexity === 'simple') stageMap[mod.stage].simple++;
            else if (mod.complexity === 'complex') stageMap[mod.stage].complex++;
            else {
                console.warn(`[VALIDATION] Invalid complexity for module ${mod.id}: ${mod.complexity}`);
            }
        });

        const stageValidation = {};
        Object.keys(stageMap).forEach(stage => {
            stageValidation[stage] = stageMap[stage].simple >= 2;
        });
        return stageValidation;
    }

    /* --- 2.3 FETCH MARKET INSIGHTS --- */
    async function fetchMarketInsights() {
        try {
            const marketData = {
                Stage1: { M01: 0.9, M02: 0.4, M03: 0.8 },
                Stage2: { M04: 0.6, M05: 0.95, M06: 0.85 },
                Stage3: { M07: 0.7, M08: 0.65, M09: 0.9, M10: 0.5 }
            };
            if (!marketData || Object.keys(marketData).length === 0) {
                throw new ArsenalError('Market data is empty or invalid', 'INVALID_MARKET_DATA');
            }
            return marketData;
        } catch (error) {
            throw new ArsenalError(`Failed to fetch market insights: ${error.message}`, 'MARKET_FETCH_ERROR');
        }
    }

    /* --- 2.4 RANK MODULES WITH MARKET DATA --- */
    async function rankModulesWithMarketData(assetInventory, stageFilter = null) {
        try {
            const marketData = await fetchMarketInsights();
            const t1Modules = filterT1Modules(assetInventory, stageFilter);

            if (t1Modules.length === 0) {
                throw new ArsenalError('No T1 modules found after filtering', 'NO_T1_MODULES');
            }

            return t1Modules
                .map(mod => {
                    const marketScore = marketData[mod.stage]?.[mod.id] || 0;
                    const complexityScore = mod.complexity === 'simple' ? 1 : mod.complexity === 'complex' ? 0.7 : 0;
                    return { ...mod, score: marketScore * 0.6 + complexityScore * 0.4 };
                })
                .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
        } catch (error) {
            throw new ArsenalError(`Ranking failed: ${error.message}`, error.code || 'RANKING_ERROR');
        }
    }

    /* --- 2.5 GROUP TOP N MODULES PER STAGE --- */
    function groupTopNModules(rankedModules, N = 3) {
        if (!Array.isArray(rankedModules)) {
            throw new ArsenalError('Ranked modules must be an array', 'INVALID_RANKED_MODULES');
        }
        if (!Number.isInteger(N) || N <= 0) {
            throw new ArsenalError('N must be a positive integer', 'INVALID_N_VALUE');
        }

        const stageGroups = {};
        rankedModules.forEach(mod => {
            if (!stageGroups[mod.stage]) stageGroups[mod.stage] = [];
            if (stageGroups[mod.stage].length < N) stageGroups[mod.stage].push(mod);
        });
        return stageGroups;
    }

    /* --- 2.6 RENDER DASHBOARD --- */
    function renderLauncherDashboard(stageGroups) {
        const container = document.getElementById('dashboard');
        if (!container) {
            throw new ArsenalError('Dashboard container element not found', 'NO_DASHBOARD_CONTAINER');
        }

        try {
            container.innerHTML = ''; // Clear previous content

            if (!stageGroups || Object.keys(stageGroups).length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = '<p>No modules available to display.</p>';
                return;
            }

            Object.keys(stageGroups).forEach(stage => {
                const stageDiv = document.createElement('div');
                stageDiv.className = 'stage-group';
                stageDiv.innerHTML = `<h3>${stage}</h3>`;
                const list = document.createElement('ul');

                stageGroups[stage].forEach(mod => {
                    if (!mod.id || !mod.score) {
                        console.warn(`[RENDER] Skipping invalid module in ${stage}: ${JSON.stringify(mod)}`);
                        return;
                    }
                    const item = document.createElement('li');
                    item.innerHTML = `${mod.id} (${mod.complexity}) â€“ Score: ${mod.score.toFixed(2)}`;
                    item.addEventListener('click', () => trackModuleSelection(mod.id));
                    list.appendChild(item);
                });

                stageDiv.appendChild(list);
                container.appendChild(stageDiv);
            });
        } catch (error) {
            throw new ArsenalError(`Dashboard rendering failed: ${error.message}`, 'RENDER_ERROR');
        }
    }

    /* --- 2.7 TELEMETRY HOOK --- */
    function trackModuleSelection(moduleId) {
        if (!moduleId || typeof moduleId !== 'string') {
            console.warn('[TELEMETRY] Invalid module ID:', moduleId);
            return;
        }
        console.log(`[TELEMETRY] Module selected: ${moduleId}`);
        // Future integration: send telemetry event to backend
    }

    /* --- 2.8 FULL EXECUTION --- */
    async function executeFullSmartArsenal(assetInventory) {
        try {
            console.log('[EXECUTION] Starting Full Smart Arsenal Launch...');

            const filtered = filterT1Modules(assetInventory);
            if (filtered.length === 0) {
                throw new ArsenalError('No valid T1 modules found', 'NO_VALID_MODULES');
            }
            const balance = validateModuleStageBalance(filtered);
            console.log('[EXECUTION] Stage Balance:', balance);

            const ranked = await rankModulesWithMarketData(assetInventory);
            console.log('[EXECUTION] Ranked Modules:', ranked);

            const topModules = groupTopNModules(ranked);
            console.log('[EXECUTION] Top Modules per Stage:', topModules);

            renderLauncherDashboard(topModules);
            console.log('[EXECUTION] Smart Arsenal Launcher V1.8 Ready.');
        } catch (error) {
            console.error(`[EXECUTION ERROR] ${error.name}: ${error.message} (Code: ${error.code})`);
            throw error;
        }
    }

    /* --- 2.9 AUDIT REPORT --- */
    function auditBoardReport(assetInventory) {
        try {
            const filtered = filterT1Modules(assetInventory);
            const balance = validateModuleStageBalance(filtered);
            const issues = Object.entries(balance)
                .filter(([_, valid]) => !valid)
                .map(([stage]) => stage);
            return { totalModules: filtered.length, balanceIssues: issues, passed: issues.length === 0 };
        } catch (error) {
            throw new ArsenalError(`Audit failed: ${error.message}`, error.code || 'AUDIT_ERROR');
        }
    }

    /* --- 2.10 PREPARE FOR GROK --- */
    function prepareForGrok(assetInventory) {
        try {
            const auditReport = auditBoardReport(assetInventory);
            const payload = {
                inventory: assetInventory,
                launcherAudit: auditReport,
                v1_3Audit: FINAL_V1_3_AUDIT_PACKAGE,
                instructions: "Smart Arsenal Launcher V1.8: Use this framework for Stage-aware, market-ranked, T1 module deployment. Integrates V1.3 audit for compliance."
            };
            console.log('[GROK HANDOFF] Payload Ready:', payload);
            return payload;
        } catch (error) {
            throw new ArsenalError(`Grok handoff preparation failed: ${error.message}`, error.code || 'GROK_HANDOFF_ERROR');
        }
    }

    /* --- EXPORTS --- */
    return {
        filterT1Modules,
        validateModuleStageBalance,
        rankModulesWithMarketData,
        groupTopNModules,
        renderLauncherDashboard,
        trackModuleSelection,
        executeFullSmartArsenal,
        auditBoardReport,
        prepareForGrok
    };
})();

/* --- 3. GLOBAL EXPOSURE AND CONSOLE REPORT --- */
if (typeof window !== 'undefined') window.SmartArsenalLauncher = SmartArsenalLauncher;

console.log('[FINAL WRAP] V1.3 Audit + V1.8 Launcher ready for Grok integration.');
console.log(JSON.stringify(FINAL_V1_3_AUDIT_PACKAGE, null, 2));
